note: NECO Accounting round 6 (R36 top-up): accounting as the language of business; input and output tax; VAT 7.5%; the ledger is no book of prime entry; source document; cash sales into the cash book; paying-in slip; cash discount N47,500; stale and crossed cheques; endorsement; compound entry; net purchases; paid-up capital; the final accounts umbrella; bank overdraft and five-year loan classifications; net book value; turnover; stock-taking; leasehold and time; provision calculation N2,000; provision deducted from debtors; internal check; the partner's current account; audit fee as expense; the ministry's estimate; return on capital 25%; the club's statement of affairs. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-5, WAEC Accounting (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
